import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    B = int(data[1])
    a = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    pq = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd and i < n - 1:
            heapq.heappush(pq, abs(a[i] - a[i+1]))
    ans = 0
    while pq and B >= pq[0]:
        B -= heapq.heappop(pq)
        ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
